0022600145.text: Both the Sacramento Kings and New Orleans Pelicans are 0-4 and still looking for their first win of the 2026-27 season, with Sacramento 15th in the West and 3.5 games back in the Pacific, and New Orleans 14th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Southwest. The Kings are 0-2 on the road and are missing Keegan Murray (ankle), Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Pelicans are without Yves Missi (knee bruise) and have Jordan Poole listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but they split 1-2 in the 2025-26 series, and Sacramento won the most recent meeting 117-113 in Sacramento on April 3, 2026.
